title: Prove optimal classical all-odd selector memory (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Prove the optimal classical retained-state memory of PR4714's complete all-odd phase selector. For every n>=2, the exact minimum is D=(n-1)(n+2)/2 bits. Every column transition can be reversible. The same lower bound holds for each known total width lambda>=2D, with position-dependent transitions and arbitrary nonlinear state encoding. At n=73 this is exactly 2700 bits, with the known-width conclusion from lambda=5400.

Claim type: scoped written proof with exact finite corroboration and an attaining reversible recognizer. This contribution was produced by Nick Petalas. No new kappa or selected-frontier change.

```text
read column x
  add its signed quotient signature to the D-bit state
accept exactly when the final state is zero

for each quotient class g
  construct a D-column prefix reaching g
  construct a D-column suffix accepting precisely that class
```

[PROOF.md](https://github.com/petalas/integer-mult-bounds/blob/55e382d5a633e8f2798baeb9cda589b6146e74d6/research/all-odd-selector-memory/PROOF.md) supplies the all-n proof. Ali Romman's [PR4714](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4714), head 4c42b1925ca589ca5a773f3e791d90b28dd79dfa, supplies the signature quotient and different-full-sector-access opening. The quotient and its coordinate compression are credited premises, not new claims or audit deliverables. Credit icekylinx, Douglas Colkitt and the retained correlated-sector/native/stream lineage. The distinguishable-continuation argument is classical; no general automata-theorem or global literature priority is claimed.

The coverage-law card is explicitly changed to a classical selector-memory question. This screens a proposed smaller exact deterministic cache, while leaving physical spectral access open. [Advance CLAIM](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19373437). Canonical main 7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a, priority revision 8 and selected PR6030 remained unchanged at the final refresh.

## Evidence

- Before: PR4714 supplies the quotient representation and leaves a different full-sector access method open. After: bounded representatives and distinguishing suffixes prove exact classical memory optimality, including separately known widths.
- Exact literal odd-vector phases corroborate all 548 states and 8464 letter transitions at n=2,3,4, including every complemented inverse transition. All 263184 prefix/suffix pairs distinguish the intended class. Twenty larger encoded fixtures through n=73 realize and undo their state; the large groups are not enumerated.
- Thirteen controls pass. Three disposable altered-code runs reject an omitted negative sign, mixed update and fixed-width padding. The checker reports zero errors and generates receipts bound to all six files.
- CPython 3.12.15, macOS arm64, standard library only. Warning-strict normal and optimized direct runs pass with identical receipts. One timed run per registered command took 4.18s and 4.19s; combined registered replay took 8.85s. These are timeout measurements, not a performance comparison. Each check is bounded to 120s.
- Final registered replay, source metadata, exact committed bytes/modes and declared source ancestry pass at 55e382d5a633e8f2798baeb9cda589b6146e74d6. Official export and declared-input coverage pass. Normal and optimized direct checks pass from a read-only Git-free export with empty PATH; all seven exported files retain their bytes and modes.

Reproduce from the repository root. Any CPython 3.12 executable may replace the exact local interpreter path below.

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/all-odd-selector-memory/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -O -W error -B research/all-odd-selector-memory/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/all-odd-selector-memory
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/all-odd-selector-memory --check-source-history --check-modes
```

Expected markers: PASS_ALL_ODD_SELECTOR_MEMORY, PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE and PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES. Direct replay needs neither Git nor predecessor files. Provenance pins retain exact source bytes without importing or replaying predecessor scientific executables.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

This counts input-dependent state at column boundaries for exact deterministic classical recognition. Immutable code and externally known position are excluded. It gives no transient-workspace, physical-memory/time or linear transfer-dimension lower bound. The 2D fixed-width threshold is sufficient and unclaimed sharp. Randomized error, multiple passes, promised inputs, other sectors and shorter known widths are outside scope.

Computing a predicate on supplied Fourier labels does not implement its spectral projector on arbitrary coefficient fields. Physical label access, native/tape/precision costs, arbitrary-input restoration, a favorable complete invoice and supplier admission remain open. All five selected framework assumptions remain. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed. No selected scientific cold replay, Lean, Docker or predecessor theorem audit ran. No local registered check is deferred to CI; a local Python linter/type checker is unavailable.

## Open next questions

- Find the least known width forcing all quotient classes to remain distinguishable. Start with exact short-width reachability and suffix classes at n=3 or n=4. A sharp bounded-width argument is missing.
- Bind the optimal selector to one fully priced non-affine physical access program. Specify how the Fourier-label predicate is obtained or used and charge every conversion and return. Physical access, restoration and a favorable complete invoice remain blockers.

## Related open work

No same-object open PR was found in the checked 500-body snapshot, final latest-100 refresh and targeted all-state searches. PR4714 is a merged predecessor. Weighted linear transfer tables and arithmetic-chirp cut spectra use different machine contracts; this result counts nonlinear deterministic classical states and computes no shared physical or linear-bond tariff. Arbitrary historical diffs and unpublished work remain coverage limits.

The completion refresh inspected the 14 other open account PRs created since the advance CLAIM. None studies the complete all-odd selector or its exact deterministic retained-state memory. No shared computed quantity disagrees, and no additional predecessor computations were run.

## CI notes

Both hosted checks passed at exact head `55e382d5a633e8f2798baeb9cda589b6146e74d6` in [Registered research packages run 41634674596](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/41634674596): `plan` in 4m38s and `replay (research/all-odd-selector-memory)` in 1m42s. The checks were read once. Separate run metadata confirms completed success and the matching head. Hosted replay certifies execution of the registered normal and optimized checks and package metadata; it does not replace the written all-n proof or establish independent human or formal proof-kernel acceptance. All registered commands and the publication/source-history/export checks also passed locally.

## Merge Danger

Door: two-way. Blast radius: isolated. Six files are added under research/all-odd-selector-memory. Shared implementations, frozen source evidence and the selected frontier are unchanged.
